claim.why_it_matters: Printed as a numbered subsection heading (sibling of 3.2.1-3.2.3, rendered as '###' on page 693); the markdown leaves it as a plain paragraph.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page 694 (XV-6) shows '3.2.4 General Rules' as a numbered subsection heading at the top of the USE FOR DEBUGGING general rules, set in the same style as 3.2.1-3.2.3 on page 693. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md, page 693 renders 3.2.1 Function, 3.2.2 General Format and 3.2.3 Syntax Rules as '###' headings (lines 25836, 25840, 25854), but line 25888 has '3.2.4 General Rules' as a plain paragraph. The text itself is present and correct, and the general rules beneath it match the page, boxes included. The defect is only the missing heading level, which is structural: it leaves the General Rules out of the document outline and anchors. It does not change meaning.
